items.evidence: GET / = 200, but desktop header/nav links rendered as 0 instead of the expected 7 tabs. Footer source text is present. Screenshot: screenshots/v1-landing-desktop.png

/library shows the summary line '10개 챕터, 71개 Q&A' but only 10 linked cards render, one per chapter start page. Distinct Q&A cards rendered on the page: 10, not 71. Screenshot: screenshots/v2-library-desktop.png
/about includes 알렉, 영감, and 출처 wording in the rendered content.

Preview tab loads demo iframes successfully for all sampled pages: ch01_q01 -> /demos/ch01/q01.html#input (200), ch05_q01 -> /demos/ch05/q01.html#front (200), ch10_q01 -> /demos/ch10/q01.html#iaas (200). ch08_q01 preview tab does not load an iframe. iframeCount=0 and the page falls back to '이 문항의 시연은 콘텐츠 PR에서 연결됩니다.', so scenario switching for IP/TCP/UDP cannot be exercised. Screenshot: screenshots/v5-ch08-q01-desktop.png

Mobile 375x667 has horizontal overflow 0 on /library and /library/1/ch01_q01, and no obvious text clipping was observed. However, no fixed chatbot FAB is rendered on the mobile learn page. Screenshots: screenshots/v6-library-mobile.png, screenshots/v6-ch01-q01-mobile.png
No dark/light toggle was rendered in the inspected production UI, so there was no toggle-specific contrast regression to report.

Radii are present (primary CTA 10px, library cards 12px), but expected shadow treatment is missing: landing primary button boxShadow='none', library card boxShadow='none' before hover and after hover.

summary: Production visual QA on 2026-04-30 found the sampled learning pages largely readable and the sampled demo iframes working for ch01/ch05/ch10, but the landing header, library card rendering, ch08_q01 preview, mobile chatbot FAB, and shadow treatment need follow-up.
next_action: Hotfix visual follow-up should restore the desktop header tabs, decide whether /library must expose all 71 Q&A cards, wire ch08_q01 preview content, add the expected mobile chatbot FAB, and align button/card shadow treatment with the design policy.
